svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
GPT-6.1 Sol cached-input pricing is $0.10 per 1 million
tokens: calculate repeat-call costs first
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-20
Three lines to check first in the
pricing table
① At the standard rate, input is $2, cached
input is $0.10, and output is $10 (all per 1
million tokens). ② Cache write is listed at…
Example calculation: 1 million input
tokens, 80% cache hit rate
Assume that, out of 1 million input tokens,
800,000 are read from the cache and 200,000 are
processed anew, with 200,000 output tokens.
Output pricing is the bigger variable
Under the same conditions, GPT-6 Sol totals
$2.56 because its cached-input rate is $0.20.
Rates vary by processing method
Under the same conditions, applying the Batch
rates—$1 for input, $0.05 for cached input, and
$5 for output—produces a total of $1.24.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
